field.label: Enable KixDNS
field.help: Enable the KixDNS service. The listen addresses themselves are part of the pipeline configuration (Pipeline Editor tab, default 0.0.0.0:5353).

field.label: Listener Label
field.help: Listener instance label, matched by pipeline selectors of type "listener_label".

field.label: Log Level
field.help: Logging verbosity (passed to the process as RUST_LOG). Output is visible under Services - KixDNS - Log File.

field.label: Debug Logging
field.help: Start the process with --debug, which also forces the log level to debug.

field.label: UDP Workers
field.help: Number of UDP worker tasks, 0 lets KixDNS use the CPU core count.
